patch.hypothesis: Miles often ignores accidentals (#/b) and mode when parsing the key from the brief, causing the written key to be off by a semitone or to default to the relative major/minor.
patch.text: When reading the brief’s key (e.g., "C#m" or "Eb major"), preserve the accidental symbol (# or b) and the mode (major/minor) exactly as given; do not strip or alter them, and do not substitute the relative major/minor unless explicitly asked.
